cues: Unpaired d electrons make these ions paramagnetic, attracted into a magnetic field.
The spin only magnetic moment is the square root of n times n plus two, in Bohr magnetons, where n is the number of unpaired electrons.
One unpaired electron gives one point seven three.
Five give five point nine two.
Iron, cobalt and nickel go further: they are ferromagnetic.
